name: proto-sibling-import-by-base-name
description: With no buf.yaml and no proto.import_paths, the import roots are buf's for a directory with no buf.yaml, the target root, besides the include roots of upstream copies: a schema file imported by its path from its own directory, which no import root holds under that path, fails its importer, which publishes nothing and carries an unresolved-import note, and the imported file is published under its path from the target root. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
